---
title: "Can we optimise against a real flight path, with the throw free?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
# The same collocated rigid body twice: once with nothing to optimise but the
# trajectory, once with the design and the throw free. Each answer is then
# re-flown through the parent's RK4, which is an independent statement of the
# same physics and the only thing that can say whether the answer was real.
held = throw_flight(n=40, free_design=False)
free = throw_flight(n=60, start=(4.5, 6.5, 0.40, 1.0))

def marched(r):
    airplane, layout = glider(**{k: r[k] for k in (
        "aspect_ratio", "tail_arm_chords", "h_tail_ratio", "h_tail_incidence")})
    return simulate(airplane, layout, ballast=r["ballast"],
                    launch_angle=r["launch_angle"], v_launch=r["v_launch"])

m_held, m_free = marched(held), marched(free)
gap = free["duration"] / m_free["duration"] - 1

assert abs(held["duration"] / m_held["duration"] - 1) < 0.02  # exact when fixed
assert gap > 0.5                        # and badly optimistic when free
assert free["alpha_max"] <= CLEAN_ALPHA + 1e-6  # stall bound held, AT THE NODES
```

::: {.hero-pair}
::: {.hero-ref}
[`{python} f"{abs(held['duration']/m_held['duration']-1):.1%}"`]{.hero-value}
[error with the design held]{.hero-label}
:::
::: {}
[`{python} f"{gap:.0%}"`]{.hero-value}
[optimistic with it free]{.hero-label}
:::
:::

**Answer.** The collocation is sound; optimising through it is not. With the
design held it reproduces the marched flight to
`{python} f"{abs(held['duration']/m_held['duration']-1):.1%}"` — so
[rigid-body collocation is not infeasible](../02-flight-path/index.qmd) once the
tumble is forbidden. Free the design and the throw and it claims
`{python} f"{free['duration']:.2f}"` s where integration gives
[`{python} f"{m_free['duration']:.2f}"` s]{.key} (@tbl-march), riding α to its
`{python} f"{free['alpha_max']:.1f}"`° bound at the nodes.

::: {.callout-warning}
## The optimiser finds the gaps between the nodes
Nothing to optimise, nothing to exploit — the error appears only when the design is free.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed

1. **One start**; the surface has several basins.
2. **Nodes chosen to bracket**, not to converge.
3. **Marched model is the reference**, finely stepped.
:::

md_table(["", "design held", "design free"], [
